title: ParkedWaitCondition
description:
What a PARKED run waits for (D115). Exactly one of five kinds, discriminated by `kind`: a CI run outcome (`ci-run`), a pull request merged or closed (`pull-request`), a remote repository created (`repository-created`), an owner decision (`owner-decision`), or other demands reaching a state (`demands`, composed ALL-of or ANY-of via `mode`). Fulfils demand `platform-vault-20260930-contracts-d115-parked-work`.

A condition is a statement of what to wait for, never a script: it carries no polling interval, no command and no authority to launch anything. Producers that observe the fact (`ci-runner` for `ci-run`/`pull-request`/`repository-created`, `demand-coordinator` for `demands`, the owner UI for `owner-decision`) publish a `parked.condition-event` whose `outcome.kind` equals this `kind`; the run's owner matches event to wait by those reference fields.

**`demands` and the envelope's `after` edge.** `demand.after` is UNCHANGED: it still only orders dispatch (every listed demand must be owner-approved before the demand may be dispatched). The `demands` kind is a separate, run-level wait on demand state; it reuses the demand id shape and adds no field to `demand.json`. `mode: all` holds once EVERY listed demand is at its `state`; `mode: any` holds once AT LEAST ONE is. Composition is one level deep on purpose: ALL-of/ANY-of apply to demands, and mixing kinds in one wait is not modelled.

`state` values: `approved` (owner-approved, the fact `after` already counts; survives archiving), `satisfied` (the target's fulfillment was validated), `archived` (the origin archived it).

oneOf.title: CiRunCondition
oneOf.description: Wait for a CI run on `commit` to reach a terminal outcome (success, failure, cancelled or timed out). The outcome, not merely completion, is what resumes the run.

commit.description: Full 40-hex lowercase commit SHA the CI run is for.

pullRequest.description: Optional. The pull request the run belongs to, when there is one.

runId.description: Optional. A specific CI run id when already known; absent = the run for `commit`.

oneOf.title: PullRequestCondition
oneOf.description: Wait for a pull request to be merged or closed.

until.description: `merged` = only a merge satisfies the wait; `closed` = only a close WITHOUT merge; `merged-or-closed` = either. A producer still reports the real outcome, so a `merged`-only wait that sees a close is surfaced to the owner, not silently dropped.

oneOf.title: RepositoryCreatedCondition
oneOf.description: Wait for a remote repository to exist (e.g. after the owner creates it).

oneOf.title: OwnerDecisionCondition
oneOf.description: Wait for a decision from the owner, made in the owner UI (`dashboard`, or Factory's bundled owner UI for its own deliveries).

decisionId.description: Stable id of the pending decision, same character set as a dispatch key; the owner UI reports the decision under it.

question.description: What the owner is asked, in words the owner UI can show as-is.

oneOf.title: DemandsCondition
oneOf.description: Wait for other demands to reach a state, ALL-of or ANY-of.
